      id: "三动态超卖",
      children: "三、动态超卖"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "超卖是资源调度中的一种资源复用方式：系统向任务提供的“可申请资源总量”可以高于当前能够同时满足的物理资源总量，前提是不同任务的实际使用峰值通常不会在同一时间出现。这样，原本属于某个任务低谷期的空闲资源就可以被其他任务利用，从而提高节点整体利用率。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["超卖依赖的是", _jsx(_components.strong, {
        children: "统计复用"
      }), "，不是物理资源凭空增加。它通常适合使用曲线有波动、任务之间峰值错开的场景；代价是多个任务同时达到需求上限时，系统必须通过限流、排队、回收或驱逐来处理资源竞争。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "通用资源模型",
      children: "通用资源模型"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "在通用的资源模型中，资源提供方通常同时记录“调度时预留多少”和“运行时最多允许使用多少”。例如一台 8 核节点上运行 8 个任务，每个任务的 request 是 1 核、limit 是 2 核：调度账本只预留 8 核，但所有任务的潜在上限合计为 16 核。这就是典型的资源超卖；只有部分任务同时突发时，节点才可能接近 8 核的物理上限。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "kubernetes-资源模型",
      children: "Kubernetes 资源模型"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Kubernetes 没有一个统一名为“超卖”的单独对象，实践中通常通过 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "requests"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "limits"
      }), " 的差异实现资源超分配。scheduler 主要根据 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "requests"
      }), " 计算节点是否还能放下 Pod；Pod 运行后，kubelet 和容器运行时会把 CPU、memory 的限制转换为 cgroup 控制项。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["CPU ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "request"
        }), " 参与调度，也通常会影响 CPU share/weight；CPU ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "limit"
        }), " 通常转换为 quota。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["memory ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "request"
        }), " 参与调度和 QoS 判断，本身不是硬上限；memory ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "limit"
        }), " 通常转换为 cgroup 的内存上限。"]
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "当所有 Pod 的 requests 总量不超过节点容量、但 limits 总量超过节点容量时，节点就具备了“允许潜在需求超过物理容量”的超卖特征。"
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["因此，", _jsx(_components.strong, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Volcano 的动态超卖增加了一层独立的扩展资源账本。离线 Pod 不把普通 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "cpu"

          children: "if"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " subCollector.CollectLocalMetrics(metric, start, window)\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h4, {
      id: "cpu",
      children: "CPU"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["CPU cgroup 文件记录的是一段时间内累计消耗的 CPU 时间，而不是某个瞬间的使用率。Volcano 因此连续读取两次累计值，使用约 1 秒的时间窗口计算这段时间内占用了多少 CPU，再换算为 millicpu。节点 CPU 还可以从 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "/host/proc/stat"
      }), " 采集；这个路径统计的是宿主机 CPU 时间，需要排除 idle 和 iowait。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "CPUResourceCollector.CollectLocalMetrics"

        children: "true"
      }), " 时，直接使用根 cgroup 用量；否则它会按 QoS cgroup 分别读取，并把选中的结果相加。", _jsx(_components.code, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {

        }), "\n    e.queue.Enqueue(overSubscriptionRes)\n}\n"]

      }), " 汇总得到的节点实时用量。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "因此，超卖前的空闲量是："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "空闲资源 = max(0, total - currentUsage)\n可上报的扩展资源 = 空闲资源 × ratio\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ratio"
      }), " 默认是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "60"
      }), "，所以 agent 只把空闲资源的 60% 交给 scheduler 使用，剩余部分不进入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "batch-*"
      }), " 资源账本。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如，一个节点的普通 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "cpu"
      }), " Allocatable 是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "8000m"
      }), "，当前 CPU 用量是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "5000m"
      }), "："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "CPU 空闲量 = 8000m - 5000m = 3000m\nbatch-cpu = 3000m × 60% = 1800m\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这里的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "1800m"
      }), " 是可以额外调度的扩展资源，不应再和普通 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "cpu: 8000m"
      }), " 相加理解成节点拥有 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "9800m"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "计算有三个细节值得注意："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ol, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["CPU 和内存的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "total"

          children: "Node.status.allocatable"
        }), " 作为总量，再与实时用量比较。"]
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {

          children: "60"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {

            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(r *historicalUsageCalculator)"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "len"
        }), "(historicalUsages) == ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"
        }), " {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), "\n    }\n    overSubRes := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "make"

          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "int64"
        }), "(", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"

          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "int64"
        }), "(", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "1"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, usage := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, res := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " apis.OverSubscriptionResourceTypes {\n            overSubRes[res] += usage[res] * initWeight\n        }\n        initWeight *= ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "2"
        }), "\n    }\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, res := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " apis.OverSubscriptionResourceTypes {\n        overSubRes[res] /= totalWeight\n    }\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " overSubRes\n}\n"]

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["可以把 cgroup 理解成 Linux 内核中的“资源控制目录”。目录本身不是普通的业务文件夹，里面的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "cpu.stat"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "六scheduler-如何使用扩展资源",
      children: "六、scheduler 如何使用扩展资源"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["动态超卖交给 scheduler 的结果，是节点上当前可以分配给离线 Pod 的一段资源额度。agent 根据实时用量计算这段额度，并写入 Node 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "status.allocatable"
      }), "；scheduler 只需要读取这个 Kubernetes Node 对象，把 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "batch-cpu"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "batch-memory"
      }), " 当作普通扩展资源参与资源匹配。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "因此，scheduler 不会重新读取 Prometheus，也不会根据 CPU 水位自己计算空闲资源。它负责的是资源账本、节点筛选和调度动作；节点压力检测、扩展资源收缩以及已有离线 Pod 的驱逐仍由 agent 处理。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "v1.15.0-alpha.0"
      }), " 中，没有一个专门名为 colocation 或 oversubscription 的 scheduler action 来调度 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "batch-*"
      }), "。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocate"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "reclaim"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "preempt"
      }), " 仍然是 Volcano 的通用调度动作，只是它们操作的资源向量中可以包含扩展资源。scheduler 侧真正与混部资源衔接的地方，主要在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "NodeInfo"
      }), " 和通用资源匹配逻辑中。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: _jsx(_components.img, {
        src: "/images/volcano-colocation-scheduler.png",
        alt: "scheduler 调度：batch-* 是调度账本"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(Mermaid, {
      chart: "flowchart TD\n    agent[agent 计算动态超卖额度] --> status[Node.status.allocatable\n    batch-cpu / batch-memory]\n    pod[离线 Pod requests\n    batch-cpu / batch-memory] --> task[TaskInfo.InitResreq\n    ScalarResources]\n    status --> cache[Scheduler cache\n    NewNodeInfo + NewResource]\n    cache --> idle[NodeInfo.Idle / FutureIdle]\n    task --> fit{资源是否满足?}\n    idle --> fit\n    fit -- 是 --> allocate[allocate\n    predicate + node order]\n    allocate --> bind[Statement.Allocate\n    绑定 Pod]\n    fit -- 否 --> action{是否配置资源冲突动作?}\n    action -- reclaim --> reclaim[reclaim\n    跨队列回收]\n    action -- preempt --> preempt[preempt\n    同队列内抢占]\n    action -- 否 --> wait[继续等待]\n    reclaim --> recheck[释放后重新检查资源]\n    preempt --> recheck\n    recheck --> bind\n    pressure[agent 节点压力处理] --> shrink[缩减 batch-* 或增加 taint]\n    shrink --> status\n"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "文字版流程可以概括为："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ol, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["agent 将动态计算出的离线资源额度写入 Node 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "status.allocatable"
        }), "，离线 Pod 在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "requests"
        }), " 中申请同名的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "batch-*"
        }), " 资源。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["scheduler cache 将 Node 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "ResourceList"
        }), " 转换为 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "NodeInfo"
        }), "，扩展资源进入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "ScalarResources"
        }), "，与 CPU、memory 一起参与资源账本。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "allocate"
        }), " 用 pending task 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "InitResreq"
        }), " 和节点的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "FutureIdle"
        }), " 做通用资源匹配；只有每个资源维度都满足时，Pod 才会被绑定。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["资源不足时，已配置的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "reclaim"
        }), " 或 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "preempt"
        }), " 可以尝试释放资源，但它们不会把普通 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "cpu"
        }), " 自动转换成 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "batch-cpu"
        }), "。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["节点压力升高后，agent 会减少下一轮可供调度的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "batch-*"
        }), " 额度，或通过 taint 阻止新的离线 Pod；已有 Pod 是否驱逐由 agent 的压力处理链路决定。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "1-扩展资源如何进入-scheduler-的资源模型",
      children: "1. 扩展资源如何进入 scheduler 的资源模型"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["离线 Pod 请求的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "kubernetes.io/batch-cpu"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "kubernetes.io/batch-memory"
      }), "，在 Kubernetes API 中属于扩展资源。scheduler 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "api.Resource"
      }), " 没有为它们增加独立字段，而是把它们放入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ScalarResources"
      }), "。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "NewResource"
      }), " 的核心代码如下："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-title",
            children: "NewResource"
          }), _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(rl v1.ResourceList)"
          })]
        }), " *Resource {\n    r := EmptyResource()\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " rName, rQuant := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " rl {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "switch"
        }), " rName {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "case"
        }), " v1.ResourceCPU:\n            r.MilliCPU += ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "float64"
        }), "(rQuant.MilliValue())\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "case"
        }), " v1.ResourceMemory:\n            r.Memory += ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "float64"
        }), "(rQuant.Value())\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "default"
        }), ":\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 扩展资源，包括 batch-cpu 和 batch-memory，进入 ScalarResources。"
        }), "\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " v1helper.IsScalarResourceName(rName) {\n                r.AddScalar(rName, ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "float64"
        }), "(rQuant.MilliValue()))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " r\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这里没有判断资源名称是否包含 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "batch"
      }), "。对 scheduler 来说，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "kubernetes.io/batch-cpu"
      }), " 只是一个独立的资源维度。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "cpu"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "kubernetes.io/batch-cpu"
      }), " 的账本彼此独立，普通 CPU 空闲不会直接填补 batch CPU 的缺口。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Node 对象进入 scheduler cache 后，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "NewNodeInfo"
      }), " 会用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Node.status.allocatable"
      }), " 初始化节点的可用资源："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-title",
            children: "NewNodeInfo"
          }), _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(node *v1.Node)"
          })]
        }), " *NodeInfo {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n    nodeInfo.setOversubscription(node)\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " node != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n        nodeInfo.Idle = NewResource(node.Status.Allocatable).\n            Add(nodeInfo.OversubscriptionResource)\n        nodeInfo.Allocatable = NewResource(node.Status.Allocatable).\n            Add(nodeInfo.OversubscriptionResource)\n    }\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " nodeInfo\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "NewResource(node.Status.Allocatable)"
      }), " 会读取 Node 中的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "batch-*"
      }), " 扩展资源。源码同时保留了从 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "volcano.sh/oversubscription-cpu"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "volcano.sh/oversubscription-memory"
      }), " 注解读取 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "OversubscriptionResource"
      }), " 的路径；当前 agent 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "extend"
      }), " 策略通过 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "UpdateNodeExtendResource"
      }), " 更新 Node 状态，阅读时需要把这条兼容路径与动态超卖的状态上报路径区分开。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.h3, {
      id: "2-allocate-使用的仍是通用资源匹配",
      children: ["2. ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocate"
      }), " 使用的仍是通用资源匹配"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocate"
      }), " 不需要为离线 Pod 增加一个特殊分支。它的资源 predicate 直接比较任务请求和节点的未来空闲资源："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(alloc *Action)"
          })]
        }), " predicate(task *api.TaskInfo, node *api.NodeInfo) ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "error"
        }), " {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "var"
        }), " statusSets api.StatusSets\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " ok, resources := task.InitResreq.LessEqualWithResourcesName(\n        node.FutureIdle(), api.Zero); !ok {\n        statusSets = ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "append"
        }), "(statusSets, &api.Status{\n            Code:   api.Unschedulable,\n            Reason: api.WrapInsufficientResourceReason(resources),\n        })\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " api.NewFitErrWithStatus(task, node, statusSets...)\n    }\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " alloc.session.PredicateForAllocateAction(task, node)\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "FutureIdle()"
      }), " 是当前空闲资源加上正在释放的资源，再减去已经 pipeline 的资源。由于 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "InitResreq"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "FutureIdle"
      }), " 都包含 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ScalarResources"
      }), "，所以当 Pod 请求 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "batch-cpu: 2"
      }), " 时，检查的就是节点当前的 batch CPU 余额，而不是普通 CPU 余额。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如，节点的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "batch-cpu"
      }), " 为 4000m，已经运行的离线 Pod 使用了 1500m，scheduler cache 中该维度的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Idle"
      }), " 约为 2500m。新的 Pod 请求 2000m 可以通过资源 predicate；如果 agent 下一次把 Node 上报的 batch CPU 调整为 800m，新的请求就会因为 batch CPU 维度不足而等待。scheduler 不会因为普通 CPU 还有空闲就放行这个 Pod。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.h3, {

        children: "ColocationConfiguration"

      children: "八、部署与排查"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "混部能力不是打开一个开关就能全部生效。agent handler、节点 label、scheduler 配置、Linux cgroup 版本、tc/eBPF 能力和业务 Pod 的 QoS/资源申请需要彼此匹配。部署时适合按“先验证节点控制，再开启动态资源供给”的顺序推进，否则很难判断问题来自隔离未生效，还是来自 scheduler 没有看到扩展资源。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(Mermaid, {
      chart: "flowchart TD\n    host[检查节点内核、cgroup、tc/eBPF 能力] --> gate[启用 agent handlers 和 feature gates]\n    gate --> label[标记 colocation 节点]\n    label --> pod[部署带 QoS 和资源申请的 Pod]\n    pod --> verify[验证 cgroup、Node status 和网络规则]\n    verify --> pressure[观察压力检测和离线驱逐]\n    pressure --> oversub[确认稳定后启用 oversubscription]\n    oversub --> batch[观察 batch-* 资源变化]\n    batch --> scheduler[验证 scheduler allocate / reclaim / preempt]\n    scheduler --> monitor[持续观察 P99、用量、Events 和限流状态]\n"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ol, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "从源码结构看，Volcano 的混部实现并不是单个调度插件，而是一条从资源账本到节点内核的控制链：scheduler 决定任务能否进入节点，agent 决定当前能卖出多少资源，cgroup/tc/eBPF 决定任务实际如何竞争资源，压力处理则为在线业务保留最后一道回收边界。"
    })]
  });
}
function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
